interview.name: Dane
interview.answer: The repair drive is still just described as a shared repair drive, with no time or location given.

reflections: Dane is responsive and willing to help once the task is clarified.
Opal is coordinating a practical repair-drive logistics task and needs support with organizing the drop-off process.
Their interaction is straightforward and cooperative, with Dane taking on a supporting role in a shared task.
Dane is reliable and takes initiative in coordinating hands-on repair-drive logistics.
Opal, Faye, and Ira each contribute by narrowing scope, confirming timing, or offering follow-through.
The group communicates in a cooperative, low-friction way, with Dane acting as the central organizer.
Dane is consistently coordinating logistics and offering hands-on help with the drop-off spot.
Ira prefers to handle things after errands and communicates progress with brief follow-ups.
Opal and Tess contribute by keeping sorting details and timing organized so Dane can align the drop-off work.
Dane is the main coordinator here and consistently offers to organize the drop-off spot and track incoming items.
Tess, Rey, and Mara all respond by promising to send timing or job details, showing a cooperative handoff of information to Dane.
The group is aligning around a workflow where parts, tool jobs, and drop-off logistics are kept centralized and communicated as details become available.
Dane is acting as the organizer and coordinator for the drop-off spot, keeping sorting orderly.
Cleo and others are offering practical help by bringing supplies and handling tools or parts.
The group is aligned around a shared repair drive, with Dane and Jules coordinating priorities for donated items.
